reason: PR Genius is primarily a project-analysis plugin for evaluating proposed open-source pull requests against repository policies, historical patterns, and status signals, while providing contribution guidance and outbound PR monitoring.

summaries.zh: PR Genius 用于根据开源项目的仓库规范、历史案例和模式分析 Pull Request，并提供提交建议与状态监测。
summaries.en: PR Genius analyzes open-source pull requests against repository policies, historical cases, and contribution patterns while providing submission guidance and status monitoring.

capabilities: Analyzes pull request titles, descriptions, and diff statistics
Checks repository-specific contribution policies and structured success or anti-patterns
Provides merge-risk assessments, triage results, and action suggestions
Lists and monitors submitted pull request status across repositories
Searches repository profiles, case studies, and contribution patterns
Saves status snapshots and provides dry-run profile writeback suggestions
